agent_votes.reason: API, OpenAPI, Postman, MCP, monitor and machine-buyer end-to-end path are working; write tests must remain bounded because of KV limits.
The product path is understandable to machines: Target Discovery, Score, Deep Analysis and Action Pack create a logical buying sequence.
Guardrails block live payment, invoicing and outreach; fiscal/legal setup is required before paid go-live.
Agent coverage is good for testing; sales ops, post-sale, admin, legal and continuous learning must be formalized before scale.

consolidated_findings: The current strongest proof is the machine-buyer end-to-end rehearsal.
MachineSignal sells machine-readable decisions and operational payloads, not human consulting.
Commercial prices and willingness-to-pay remain beta assumptions until controlled external sandbox/draft evidence exists.
Monitor jobs should stay NoWrite and write-capped tests must remain deliberate, limited and idempotent.
Fiscal, legal and admin readiness are the main blockers before paid go-live.
Machine-readable public assets, API directories, Postman and MCP/agent registries remain the right channels.
recommended_next_action: Run a NoWrite public/draft channel readiness review that checks whether a machine can understand the three approved test paths from public assets alone. If it passes, proceed to one owner-approved sandbox-only external draft channel.
